task.description:
Implement ISS-501..504 on branch feature/WF02-iss501-504-epic5-20260612. Follow design docs exactly. Prerequisites: ISS-107 RELEASED (public.tenants.storage_mode column exists).

IMPLEMENT IN DEPENDENCY ORDER:

ISS-501 (src/api/middleware/tenant_context.zig, src/db/*):
- Read public.tenants.storage_mode for the resolved tenant
- LEGACY_RLS: SET search_path TO public; SET bpm.tenant_id = tenant_uuid (RLS predicate active)
- SCHEMA: SET search_path TO tenant_{slug}, public
- Pin routing at request start; never mix paths within one request
- Apply tenant context in middleware before any query runs

ISS-502 (src/admin/tenant_migration.zig):
- Copy all rows from public tables to tenant_{slug} schema
- Verify parity: row count + checksum per table
- Atomically UPDATE public.tenants SET storage_mode='SCHEMA' WHERE id=$tenant_id AND storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS'
- All in one transaction; failure → rollback (tenant stays LEGACY_RLS)
- Idempotent: check storage_mode first; if already SCHEMA, no-op

ISS-503 (migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql, store modules):
- Guard: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenants WHERE storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' — must be 0
- Drop RLS policies from all tables that have them
- Remove bpm.tenant_id column from tables where it exists (if not needed)
- Remove bpm.tenant_id session variable default setting
- Migration must be idempotent

ISS-504 (src/db/provisioning.zig, test suite):
- Ensure public.schema_migrations tracks GBL- migrations (schema_name='public' rows)
- Ensure each tenant_{slug}.schema_migrations tracks per-tenant migrations
- New tenant provisioning: create schema_migrations in tenant schema, record applied versions
- Update ADP-12 default-tenant regression test
- Ensure zig build migrate works for both public and per-tenant schemas

After all 4: zig build (exit 0), zig build test (exit 0). Commit and push.
acceptance_criteria: ISS-501: storage_mode routing enforced, LEGACY_RLS vs SCHEMA paths separated
ISS-502: cutover transaction atomic, rollback-safe, idempotent, parity verified
ISS-503: RLS guard, policies dropped, migration idempotent
ISS-504: dual schema_migrations tracking works, provisioning creates per-tenant ledger
